title: 二口消火栓
description: フランジ、六角ボルト、キャップ、保持チェーンを個別に造形した汎用消火栓。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Generic two-outlet hydrant with cast barrel profile, bolted flanges, removable-looking caps, wrench nuts and individually modeled retaining-chain links. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
